# CPU-free SID 8580 Preview

The browser chip adapter uses the existing endpoint WASM's sid8p batch API.
It does not instantiate the C64 machine or call JavaScript once per chip cycle.
See [the readable host module](../sid8580.js) and its
[type declarations](../sid8580.d.ts). These remain separate, unminified
files at the runtime package root.

The unchanged matching native source kit is [sid8580-machine/README.md](sid8580-machine/README.md).
Its 99 compiled inputs produce both checked WASMs under generated/sid8580-machine.
Both outputs and the receipt are retained for independent rebuilding, although
this CPU-free Synth/Playground adapter loads only sid8580-endpoint.wasm. Profiles stay Off.
Rust/MIT, C64/zlib and Tetorica/BSD licenses and toolchain notices are preserved
inside the matching source kit. No Native binary, user firmware, song or PCM is included.
